alt: Fingernail anatomy (Blausen) - nail plate (the visible nail, made of dead keratinized cells), nail bed (vascular tissue underneath that gives the pink color), lunula (white crescent at base = visible part of matrix), cuticle (eponychium) protecting the matrix, free edge distally, hyponychium under it.
